meetings.title: Q2 Architecture Decision Record - Authentication & Mobile Standards
meetings.raw_transcript:
Elena Vance: We are ratifying ADR-24. We select PostgreSQL + Supabase as our unified identity and database stack for all microservices. Any changes to auth requires formal architectural review.
Marcus Chen: Agreed. For mobile, Mobile v2.0 iOS release must maintain full backward compatibility with iOS 15+ to protect 28% of our enterprise customer base.
Elena Vance: Also, Mobile v2.0 global public release is locked for October 15th to align with the Q4 marketing push.
meetings.summary: Ratified ADR-24 for unified Supabase auth, mandated iOS 15+ backward compatibility, and locked October 15 launch date.

meetings.title: Enterprise Security & Infrastructure Sync
meetings.raw_transcript:
David Miller: All external API integrations must enforce OAuth2 with PKCE and pass third-party pen-testing before going live.
Sofia Martinez: Confirmed. Also, Sofia Martinez is designated as the sole code-freeze gatekeeper for production releases.
meetings.summary: Enforced OAuth2 PKCE security standard and designated Sofia as release gatekeeper.

meetings.title: Operations & Growth Strategy Review
meetings.raw_transcript:
Jordan Lee: We decided to freeze all Google Ads spend adjustments until month-end so we can measure clean attribution.
Carlos Mendes: Understood, I will focus on referral channels instead.
meetings.summary: Enacted marketing ad-spend freeze through end of month to calibrate attribution baseline.
